title: (maintainability) The Windows release links a stored PGO profile whose staleness warnings are switched off.

(performance on phones and Linux and Mac): the game module's profile (native/pgo/game.profdata) names functions as the Windows build mangles them, so the Android, Linux and Apple builds turn NEBULA_PGO into ThinLTO alone (native/CMakeLists.txt:384-393), by the file's own table about 7 % of the game's CPU against about 17 % with the profile (:379-386).
note: Found by the readall harness's native report (11-18, read at 0c98b11c2) and checked by reading every line cited at 241395b49. Modern form: a second profile trained on an Itanium-ABI build (the same tour, tools/gate/pgo.py make on Linux or Android) linked into those modules, with P-014's staleness check on both; -ffp-contract=off keeps the results bit for bit. Replay identical. The 7 and 17 % are the comment's, to be measured on the tablet.
